sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Equinix Sees AI Driving Data Center Demand, Interconnection Growth
feed.summary: Equinix executives indicate that artificial intelligence is significantly accelerating demand for high-density data center capacity and interconnection services, requiring more complex, low-latency infrastructure. The company's interconnection business grew 9% this year, supported by new offerings like Fabric One and Inference Exchange, which address the complex networking needs of AI workloads. Equinix anticipates 9%-12% annual adjusted funds from operations per-share growth through 2029, driven by robust demand and development projects generating mid-20% cash yields.

feed.title: KeyCorp Reaffirms 2026 Outlook as Loan Growth, Margins and Fees Gain Momentum
feed.summary: KeyCorp has reaffirmed its 2026 outlook, citing strong client activity, anticipated commercial loan growth at the higher end of its 4-5% target, improved credit quality, and deposit growth exceeding 2% in the latter half of the year. The bank raised its fee-income growth outlook to 4-5% following the Clearwater acquisition and is increasingly confident in achieving a core return on tangible common equity of over 15% by 2027. Despite a changing economic backdrop with expected rate increases, KeyCorp sees continued healthy activity in both lending and fee-based businesses.

feed.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical (RARE) First-In-Disease Gene Therapy Approval For FAYUVI
feed.summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical received full FDA approval for FAYUVI (UX111), a first-in-disease gene therapy for pediatric Sanfilippo syndrome Type A, alongside a Priority Review Voucher. This approval, coupled with another recent gene therapy approval for GENGLYCOS, expands Ultragenyx's commercial gene therapy portfolio. While these approvals improve the near-term outlook, investors should consider the company's high cash burn and potential for dilution, as the speed of adoption and reimbursement will be crucial for reaching profitability goals.

feed.title: Keysight Technologies Sees AI Data-Center Boom, Targets 6G and Defense Growth
feed.summary: Keysight Technologies is experiencing strong demand from AI data-center buildouts, particularly in high-speed networking and silicon photonics, and is targeting future growth in 6G wireless, aerospace and defense, and software-defined vehicles. Despite supply constraints, the company is expanding capacity and expects to maintain high incremental margins while investing in R&D to capture these emerging opportunities.

feed.title: Intel, Apple, Nvidia and More: 5 Stocks Investors Couldn't Stop Buzzing About This Week
feed.summary: This article highlights the five stocks that retail investors were most interested in this week: Intel, Apple, Nvidia, Nebius Group, and Oracle. These companies, spanning various tech sectors, saw significant discussion on social media platforms like X and Reddit, driven by factors such as AI infrastructure developments, earnings, and corporate news. The report provides a brief overview of the key events and stock performance for each company during the week.

feed.title: Equinix Plans $5B-$7B Annual Data Center Buildout as AI Demand Accelerates
feed.summary: Equinix plans to invest $5 billion to $7 billion annually in data center development, primarily in existing markets, driven by accelerating AI adoption among enterprise customers. The company aims for cash-on-cash returns in the low 20% range and expects to significantly increase its power capacity under development. Executives emphasized a customer-centric approach, building infrastructure where demand is visible and preparing facilities for higher-density AI workloads.

feed.title: NVIDIA Corporation $NVDA Holdings Decreased by a16z Perennial Management L.P.
feed.summary: a16z Perennial Management L.P. significantly reduced its holdings in NVIDIA Corporation by 91.4% in the second quarter, selling 34,015 shares and retaining 3,200 shares. Despite this, institutional investors still own a majority of NVIDIA stock, and the company reported strong financial results with revenue up 105.9% year-over-year and analysts maintaining a "Buy" rating. However, insider sales and potential risks like competition and rising memory costs are noted as areas of investor focus.

feed.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rejects Calls to Slow Down AI Development: ‘We Are Going to Go as Fast We Can, But…’
feed.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has rejected calls to slow down AI development, asserting that the industry should advance as quickly as possible while ensuring product safety. He emphasized the importance of rapid AI progress for U.S. economic growth, even as other tech leaders like Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg have voiced concerns about the pace and called for increased safety measures and independent evaluations. Huang's comments come as Nvidia's stock continues to perform strongly amid surging AI demand.

feed.title: Blue Bird (NASDAQ:BLBD) Rating Increased to Buy at Wall Street Zen
feed.summary: Wall Street Zen has upgraded Blue Bird (NASDAQ:BLBD) from a "hold" to a "buy" rating, contributing to the stock's overall positive analyst sentiment, which includes an average "Buy" rating and a consensus price target of $85.33. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding both EPS and revenue estimates. Despite shares opening below moving averages, institutional investors hold a significant portion of the company, though COO Jeffrey Sanfrey recently sold a number of shares.

feed.title: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Aehr Test Systems vs. Super Micro Computer
feed.summary: This article compares Aehr Test Systems and Super Micro Computer, two companies integral to the artificial intelligence sector, to determine which might be a better investment. Aehr Test Systems provides semiconductor testing equipment, while Super Micro Computer builds high-performance server racks for AI chips. Despite recent controversies and a negative free cash flow, the author favors Super Micro due to its strong revenue growth, profitability, and lower valuation compared to Aehr, which has experienced declining revenue and a net loss.

feed.title: KKR Sees AI Financing, Private Credit Fueling Its Next Growth Wave
feed.summary: KKR & Co. Inc. anticipates significant growth driven by private credit and AI-related financing, with its credit platform managing around $300 billion. The firm sees substantial demand for AI infrastructure financing, estimating $7.6 trillion in hyperscaler capital expenditures over five years. KKR also highlights Asia as a long-term private-credit opportunity, potentially requiring $800 billion in capital.

feed.title: Ross Gerber Sees Jensen Huang’s Charisma As Part Of Nvidia’s Edge, Says ‘This Is Why I Own Nvidia’ After Dreamforce Exchange With Marc Benioff: 'Big is Unnecessary'
feed.summary: Investor Ross Gerber highlighted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's charisma at Salesforce's Dreamforce 2026, viewing his stage presence and humor as key to Nvidia's leadership and success. Gerber, CEO of Gerber Kawasaki, reiterated his bullish stance on Nvidia, citing Huang's vision for AI infrastructure and the company's strong financial performance, including a significant revenue increase and optimistic Q3 forecast. This reinforces his belief that Nvidia is a strong investment, despite its high valuation.

feed.title: Here’s When Jim Cramer Thinks Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) Will Cut Prices
feed.summary: Jim Cramer has been closely following Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) due to a recent stock price drop of over 18% since May. Despite the weakness, Cramer defends Costco, citing its ability to use scale and the potential for price cuts as reasons for optimism. However, the company faces scrutiny over its valuation, trading at a forward P/E of 45, though it continues to show strong sales growth in both physical stores and digital channels.

feed.title: NVIDIA Vs Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC): Here’s The One Jim Cramer Likes
feed.summary: Jim Cramer has expressed a preference for Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) over NVIDIA, citing Intel's strong year-to-date gains and higher valuation. Despite NVIDIA's dominance in AI GPUs, Cramer believes Intel's foundry business and focus on agentic AI CPUs position it well for future demand, especially in areas like robotics and autonomous driving. However, Intel faces challenges with significant capital expenditure for its foundry segment, while NVIDIA continues to see strong demand for its AI chips, reflected in its robust data center revenue growth.

feed.title: Vistra Corp (VST) — Power Infrastructure Play for Data Centers Beyond Nuclear
feed.summary: Vistra Corp (VST) reported strong Q2 2026 results, with over 30% year-over-year growth in Adjusted EBITDA, driven by increasing demand for reliable power from data centers. The company is strategically positioning itself through acquisitions, long-term power purchase agreements with hyperscale operators like Amazon Web Services and Meta, and a partnership in Helix Digital Infrastructure. Key investor takeaways include the upcoming Cogentrix acquisition, potential upside from nuclear production tax credits, and the decreasing hedge coverage which will increase sensitivity to wholesale electricity prices.

feed.title: Ciena Targets $14B Revenue by 2029 as Optical Demand Outruns Supply
feed.summary: Ciena (NYSE:CIEN) has outlined ambitious financial goals, targeting approximately $14 billion in revenue by fiscal 2029, supported by a 30% annual growth rate and strong margins, as demand for optical systems continues to exceed supply. The company plans to invest heavily in R&D, commit to returning at least 70% of free cash flow to shareholders, and revise its reporting structure in fiscal 2027 to align with a projected $52 billion total addressable market by 2029. Ciena's strategy focuses on organic growth, strategic acquisitions, and addressing the persistent supply constraints in the optical industry, which are not expected to balance before 2028.

feed.title: Nvidia-Backed Cloud Startup Nscale Files for IPO
feed.summary: Nvidia-backed cloud computing company Nscale has filed for an initial public offering (IPO) on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol NSCL. The U.K.-based company did not disclose the number of shares it plans to offer or the pricing details in its filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

feed.title: SpaceX Stock Is Down 33% From Its High. Here's Why Morgan Stanley Thinks There's 106% Upside From Here.
feed.summary: SpaceX's stock (SPCX) has dropped 33% from its high, but Morgan Stanley maintains a "buy" rating with a $300 price target, implying 106% upside. The bank's bullish outlook is largely driven by SpaceX's potential in AI, with analysts highlighting the company's ability to aggressively scale its AI compute infrastructure, which is expected to be cheaper, faster, and more energy-efficient than competitors. While SpaceX is known for its space endeavors, AI is predicted to be the primary driver of its valuation for years to come.

feed.title: Nvidia-Backed Data Center Firm Nscale Files Publicly for IPO
feed.summary: Nscale, an AI data center developer backed by Nvidia and Microsoft, has filed for an Initial Public Offering in New York. The London-based company reported a net loss of $1.02 billion on revenues of $140.6 million for the first six months of the year, intending to use IPO funds to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

feed.title: SMR Developer Holtec Just Cancelled Its IPO. Should NuScale Power and Oklo Investors Panic?
feed.summary: Holtec International, a developer of small modular reactors (SMRs), canceled its IPO, citing market sentiment against the AI data center economy. While Holtec's IPO cancellation might seem concerning for other SMR developers like NuScale Power and Oklo, the article suggests investors shouldn't panic. Holtec intends to attempt another IPO in 3-6 months, and government support for SMRs is rising, indicating a potential rebound for the sector.

feed.title: Intel vs. SK Hynix: Which Chip Stock Is Worth Chasing After This Week's Surge?
feed.summary: Intel (INTC) and SK Hynix (SKHY) have seen their stock prices surge this week due to reports of potential memory chip manufacturing partnerships in the U.S., specifically involving Intel's Ohio complex. While Intel's turnaround shows promise with strong Q2 results and a positive outlook for 2026 and 2027, its valuation is currently high. SK Hynix, on the other hand, benefits from its leadership in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI accelerators, boasts impressive growth projections, and trades at a significantly lower forward P/E multiple, making it a "Buy" according to Zacks Investment Research, while Intel is rated a "Hold."

feed.title: Brad Gerstner Says AI Labs Need $180B Revenue Run Rate to Keep Nvidia Trade Alive
feed.summary: Brad Gerstner of Altimeter Capital asserts that leading AI labs, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI (owned by SpaceX), must collectively increase their annualized revenue run rate from an estimated $100 billion to $180 billion by year-end to sustain the current AI investment trend. He highlights that this significant revenue growth is crucial to justify the immense capital expenditure by tech giants like Microsoft and Alphabet, who are building AI infrastructure for these labs to rent. Gerstner, whose firm holds substantial stakes in Nvidia and the mentioned AI labs, emphasized that the AI sector's revenue generation is the most critical data point for the market.

feed.title: IonQ, Synopsys Research Shows Quantum Boost Can Cut Simulation Time by Up to 14.6%
feed.summary: IonQ and Synopsys have demonstrated that integrating quantum algorithms into engineering simulation software can reduce processing time for complex industrial models by up to 14.6%. This research, presented at IEEE Quantum Week 2026, involved tests on various components using up to 150 simulated qubits and validation on IonQ's 36-qubit Forte system, earning a Best Paper Award. Additionally, IonQ collaborated on generative AI methods for quantum optimization circuits, which significantly cut down circuit generation time.

feed.title: This Crude Refiner Has Beaten Every Magnificent Seven Stock in the Last 2 Years
feed.summary: Valero Energy Corp. (VLO), a crude oil refiner, has significantly outperformed all Magnificent Seven stocks over the past two years, with a 203.8% rally. This performance is attributed to the widening crack spread as geopolitical disruptions have tightened both crude and refined product markets, leading to record refining margins. Despite its strong performance and earnings, the average Wall Street analyst target price for Valero is still considerably below its current trading price, though recent analyst revisions show higher targets.

feed.title: Arrow Electronics and ST Microelectronics accelerate industrial AMR development with a new reference platform
feed.summary: Arrow Electronics, along with its subsidiary eInfochips, and ST Microelectronics have jointly launched a new industrial autonomous mobile robot (AMR) reference platform. This platform aims to expedite the development and deployment of professional service robots by providing a pre-validated, fully functional kit built on ST's components and integrated with NVIDIA's Jetson Orin Nano compute platform and ROS 2 software. The collaboration offers a robust system-level design to reduce development risk and time-to-market for robot manufacturers and system integrators.

feed.title: Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) Caps Xbox Cloud Gaming Hours For Game Pass Subscribers Starting November
feed.summary: Microsoft is implementing monthly time limits for Xbox Cloud Gaming for Game Pass subscribers starting in November, ending unlimited streaming access. Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, and Essential subscribers will face caps of 15, 10, and 5 hours respectively, with options to purchase additional hours. This strategic shift aims to improve the gaming division's financial performance and control rising infrastructure costs, though it risks pushing heavy streamers to rival services like Nvidia’s GeForce Now.

feed.title: Exploring The Competitive Space: NVIDIA Versus Industry Peers In Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equip
feed.summary: This article analyzes NVIDIA (NVDA) against its competitors in the Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment industry, focusing on financial metrics, market position, and growth potential. NVIDIA shows signs of undervaluation with a P/E ratio below the industry average, yet boasts strong profitability and operational efficiency as indicated by high ROE, EBITDA, gross profit, and revenue growth. The company also demonstrates a robust financial position with a lower debt-to-equity ratio compared to its peers.

feed.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Tempus, Moderna, Super Micro Computer and Aya Gold & Silver
feed.summary: Zacks Investment Ideas highlights several stocks including NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Moderna, Super Micro Computer, and Aya Gold & Silver, noting their resilience despite market uncertainties in 2026. The article argues that while macroeconomic and geopolitical factors have caused fear, investor sentiment is overly negative, and historical data suggests potential for a strong market rally into year-end, especially for AI-related stocks. It emphasizes focusing on price action over news headlines and refutes overblown AI safety concerns.

feed.title: Chip Rally To Sustain? Intel, SanDisk, Micron, Nvidia, SK Hynix Futures Edge Higher Day After Up To 10% Surge
feed.summary: Semiconductor stocks, including Intel, SanDisk, Micron, Nvidia, and SK Hynix, extended their rally in pre-market trading on Friday after significant gains on Thursday. This surge is attributed to supply constraints, resilient AI demand, and positive comments from Intel's CEO about meeting only half of customer CPU demand. Additionally, exploratory talks between SK Hynix and Intel for potential memory-chip manufacturing in the US further boosted investor sentiment.

feed.title: NVIDIA CEO Says AI Spending Flywheel Is ‘Really, Really Flying’
feed.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang stated that demand for AI computing is rapidly accelerating, driven by the increasing utility of AI and companies building "AI factories." He highlighted that these NVIDIA-powered AI factories offer significant returns on investment and that AI safety efforts are creating an additional demand engine for data centers. Huang also noted that rising GPU rental prices are boosting revenue forecasts and prompting further investment in infrastructure, forming a robust "flywheel" effect.

feed.title: SK hynix Launches ‘SK hynix Ventures’ in Silicon Valley to Expand Global AI Ecosystem Investment
feed.summary: SK hynix has launched "SK hynix Ventures," its new corporate venture capital (CVC) brand, in Silicon Valley to expand its investments across the global AI ecosystem. The company plans to target areas such as AI computing, data centers, system software, and optical interconnect, aiming to foster technological cooperation with global VCs and startups. This initiative marks an evolution in SK hynix's CVC strategy, moving from tech sensing to actively driving collaborative innovation in the AI industry.

feed.title: Nykredit A S Buys New Holdings in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
feed.summary: Nykredit A S recently acquired 645,037 shares of Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) valued at approximately $384.2 million, making it their 11th largest portfolio holding. Despite significant insider selling totaling over $105.5 million in the past 90 days, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $565.12. AMD reported strong Q2 earnings, with revenue up 50.1% year-over-year to $11.54 billion and EPS of $1.66, surpassing expectations.

feed.title: Van Hulzen Asset Management LLC Has $31.69 Million Stock Holdings in International Business Machines Corporation $IBM
feed.summary: Van Hulzen Asset Management LLC reduced its stake in International Business Machines (IBM) by 2.3% in the second quarter, holding 112,688 shares valued at $31.69 million. IBM is expanding its quantum computing and enterprise AI efforts, including a $1 billion CHIPS Act award for a quantum wafer foundry and new collaborations for its watsonx platform. Despite a recent market decline, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $265, and IBM pays a quarterly dividend of $1.69.

feed.title: Boston Trust Walden Corp Has $252.65 Million Stake in NVIDIA Corporation $NVDA
feed.summary: Boston Trust Walden Corp significantly increased its stake in NVIDIA Corporation, now holding 1,262,697 shares valued at over $252 million, making it their 5th largest position. Other institutional investors have also adjusted their holdings in NVIDIA. The article details NVIDIA's financial performance, including its recent earnings beat, dividend announcement, and analyst ratings, alongside recent insider trading activity and market sentiment factors.

feed.title: Micron Jumps 5% as Intel CEO Says Memory Prices Have Surged Over 500%
feed.summary: Micron Technology (MU) shares jumped over 5% after Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan stated that memory chip prices have surged by 500-700% due to limited supply and high AI demand, with bottlenecks expected to worsen in 2027. This aligns with warnings from other industry leaders like SK Hynix, and projections suggest prices could be six times their mid-2025 level by the end of 2026. Micron is already seeing significant profit increases, and new factory production is not expected to fully ease the shortage until 2028 or 2029, suggesting continued benefits from high prices.

feed.title: Snap Advances 4% as Specs Glasses Add Salesforce and NVIDIA Enterprise Tools; Meta Holds Steady
feed.summary: Snap stock advanced 4% after the company announced its $2,195 Specs AR glasses will integrate with Salesforce Agentforce and NVIDIA AI, repositioning them as enterprise hardware. While Meta Platforms saw little reaction, indicating investors view Snap's move as non-competitive, Snap still needs to convert enterprise interest into actual purchase orders to boost revenue. The stock remains down 28% year-to-date, with shipping beginning later this fall in select regions.

feed.title: Huang says Nvidia’s chip sales will double next year
feed.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced that the company expects to double its chip sales next year, citing the significant contributions of AI to various industries and economies. This projection comes after Nvidia forecast 70% growth in the fiscal year ending January 2028, reaching approximately $673 billion. Huang made these remarks at a summit with King Charles III in Scotland, where he also discussed AI safety alongside other tech leaders.

feed.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Puts a Clock on Free Xbox Cloud Gaming
feed.summary: Microsoft is implementing monthly time limits on free Xbox Cloud Gaming for Game Pass subscribers starting in November, a change aimed at improving the economics of the service. While this affects only about 4% of heavy users, it could lead to increased churn or prompt users to switch to competing services like Nvidia's GeForce Now. The move reflects Microsoft's effort to align revenue with computing resources consumed and prioritize profitability in its gaming division.

feed.title: Alpha Compute Corp president Villani buys $108,987 in shares
feed.summary: Alpha Compute Corp President and Chairman, Fiorenzo Villani, purchased $108,987 worth of company shares between September 14-16, 2026. These direct and indirect acquisitions come as the stock is considered undervalued by InvestingPro, despite a significant year-over-year drop. The company recently reported a wider net loss for fiscal 2026, but saw increased cash reserves and is transitioning to focus on AI infrastructure.

feed.title: Prediction: A $5,000 Investment Split Between Micron and Sandisk Will Triple Before 2028
feed.summary: An analysis suggests that a $5,000 investment split between Micron and Sandisk could triple before 2028, driven by massive demand for memory chips due to the growth in artificial intelligence. Both companies are experiencing significant revenue growth, and despite their strong performance in 2026, their stocks are trading at attractive valuations compared to historical levels. The author believes analysts may be underestimating their potential for 2027.

feed.title: $500,000 Split Between VOO and QQQ Owns the Same Seven Stocks Twice, and Nobody Adds Up the Overlap
feed.summary: Investing a combined $500,000 into popular ETFs VOO and QQQ results in significant overlap, with approximately $167,000 concentrated in the same seven mega-cap stocks. This apparent diversification actually leads to duplication and higher fees, as QQQ's expense ratio is six times that of VOO. The article suggests replacing QQQ with lower-cost alternatives like QQQM or SPLG to maintain exposure while reducing redundant costs.

feed.title: Insider Selling: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) EVP Sells 17,261 Shares
feed.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) EVP Forrest Norrod sold 17,261 shares of the company's stock for approximately $8.68 million, reducing his holdings by 4.54%. This transaction was conducted under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Despite competitive risks and a high valuation, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for AMD, which recently reported better-than-expected quarterly results and shows strong year-over-year revenue growth.

feed.title: SiTime (NASDAQ:SITM) Stock Price Up 9.3% - Should You Buy?
feed.summary: SiTime (NASDAQ:SITM) saw its stock price increase by 9.3% to approximately $599.71, despite trading volume being 83% below average. Analysts maintain a "Buy" rating with an average price target of $717.78, and quarterly results exceeded expectations with EPS of $2.34 and revenue up 126.5% year over year. However, the stock's high P/E ratio of 1,225.56 and recent insider sales totaling $9.1 million are noted as potential concerns.

feed.title: Nvidia, Google and Emerald AI launch flexible data center consortium
feed.summary: Nvidia, Google, and Emerald AI have formed the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA) to promote and standardize flexible data centers. These facilities can reduce their power consumption during peak demand or even feed power back into the grid using on-site batteries, optimizing energy usage and supporting grid stability. AEMA's initial focus will be on developing best practices and standard metrics for these flexible data centers.

feed.title: AI Security Debate — Amazon Says AI Models To Be Released Only When 'Ready And Safe'
feed.summary: Amazon has stated that artificial intelligence models should only be released after extensive vetting and safety checks, advocating for collaboration between tech leaders and government bodies to manage deployment risks. This stance aligns Amazon with partners like OpenAI and Anthropic, amidst a growing Silicon Valley debate on government-mandated AI safeguards. The company emphasizes that consumer security should not be compromised for technological advancement and that releasing unverified models creates systemic market risks.

feed.title: Why Investors May Want to Buy Procter & Gamble if Consumer Spending Cools
feed.summary: As consumer confidence declines, investors may seek resilient stocks. Procter & Gamble (PG) is presented as a strong candidate due to its 70-year history of dividend increases, well-funded dividends, and diversified portfolio of essential consumer staples. Its current stock price is down from its 52-week high, making its dividend yield attractive for income-oriented investors.

feed.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
feed.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced that the company expects to double its chip sales next year, driven by the significant contributions of AI across various industries and economies. This forecast follows the company's recent projection of 70% growth for the fiscal year ending in January 2028. Huang also discussed AI safety during a summit with King Charles III, emphasizing the importance of engineering safe products.

feed.title: Avantor Inc stock hits 52-week high at 15.94 USD
feed.summary: Avantor Inc (AVTR) reached a new 52-week high of $15.94, driven by a 100% return over the past six months and a 36% year-to-date increase. This growth is supported by positive Q2 2026 results, surpassing Wall Street expectations, and subsequent analyst upgrades from Wolfe Research and Jefferies. Despite the positive momentum, InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock might be slightly overvalued at current levels.

feed.title: MediaTek Stock Surpasses Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) In Market Cap As Dimensity 9600 Pro Targets Premium Smartphone Turf
feed.summary: MediaTek's market capitalization has surpassed Qualcomm's, with MediaTek reaching $223 billion compared to Qualcomm's $200.6 billion. This lead is further extended by MediaTek's new Dimensity 9600 Pro processor, built on TSMC's 2-nanometer process, which targets the premium smartphone market at a more competitive price. The article highlights how investor focus has shifted towards AI infrastructure partnerships, as demonstrated by Nvidia's $3.5 billion investment in MediaTek, rather than solely on handset market share battles.

feed.title: IonQ Climbs 9% on Quantum Optimization Work With NVIDIA; D-Wave Rises 8%, Rigetti Gains 7%
feed.summary: IonQ surged 9% due to research showing its quantum circuit generation time remains constant as problem sizes scale, a collaboration with NVIDIA, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, and the University of Tennessee. This news also caused other quantum computing stocks like D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Quantum Computing Inc. to rise in sympathy. However, the modest 2% gain of the Defiance Quantum ETF suggests that this is more of a speculative bet on IonQ's specific story rather than a broad re-pricing of the quantum computing industry, and investors should watch if this research translates into paying customers.
